children: Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) is leveraging a $9.3B hyperscaler AI-infrastructure win and $4B FY AI revenue to push its Cisco AI POD for Splunk and expanded Splunk-AWS security tie-ups, moves that helped CSCO stock jump as Tokenomics features open new monetization paths.
Cisco Systems, Inc. AI Revenue Milestone
: Cisco (CSCO) booked $9.3B hyperscaler AI-infrastructure orders for fiscal 2026 (about 14.7% of $63.3B revenue), $4B in Q4; FY AI revenue $4B, guidance $7.5B for FY2027.
: Cisco launched Cisco AI POD for Splunk 1.0: on‑prem, air‑gapped AI infra with Cisco compute, Nvidia GPUs, Kubernetes/OpenShift, supports self‑hosted LLMs (Gemma 4, GPT‑OSS 20B, Nemotron).
Cisco Expanded Splunk Agentic SOC, AWS Deal

: Cisco (CSCO) expanded its Splunk Agentic SOC Workforce and signed a multi-year AWS deal to co-develop integrated Splunk-AWS security tools for faster, scalable detection, investigation and response.
Cisco Stock Rises After Splunk Tokenomics
: Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock jumped ~3.3% to about $111.26 after Splunk added Tokenomics features that could enable Cisco to monetize AI infrastructure or security/observability layers.
